notes: While a game or video fills the screen, the menu behind it rests: it stops redrawing, its animations and Home banner hold still, and the chat check pauses, so the game gets the computer to itself. It wakes with the right time the moment the menu is back in front. The clock, coins, warnings and the time card over the game carry on as before. The switch is Resting behind fullscreen games on the System page, on by default; turn it off on a PC with two screens.
